name: Prime Energy Services LLC
old_description: Keep your home solar system operating at peak performance with inspections, repairs, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
about:
Prime Energy Services LLC is based in Milford, Connecticut, and was founded in 2006. The company has over 20 years of experience in the renewable energy industry, serving homeowners and businesses throughout Connecticut.

The company provides a range of solar energy services including system inspections, performance evaluations, inverter troubleshooting, monitoring system repairs, panel replacement, critter guard installation, wiring inspections, panel removal and reinstallation, and preventative maintenance programs for both residential and commercial properties. It also maintains, diagnoses, and optimizes battery storage systems for backup power and energy independence.

Prime Energy Services works with residential and commercial solar system owners across Connecticut. Its technicians service systems regardless of who originally installed them, addressing the needs of customers whose original installers are no longer available.

The company emphasizes education, transparency, and innovation, aiming to help customers understand the value of solar power. Its team focuses on identifying issues early, minimizing downtime, and maximizing long-term energy production to protect customers' solar investments.
